kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننغسل (form VII)
# نَنْغَسِلُ (nanḡasilu) /nan.ɣa.si.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْغَسَلَ (inḡasala)
# نَنْغَسِلَ (nanḡasila) /nan.ɣa.si.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْغَسَلَ (inḡasala)
# نَنْغَسِلْ (nanḡasil) /nan.ɣa.sil/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْغَسَلَ (inḡasala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
